source.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one isolated SOUTH/front-facing Player warrior sample for Solo vs Mortal native pixel-readability calibration. Reference 1 is approved palette/camera/mood ONLY; reference 2 is existing Player identity. Preserve dark-haired human, ash dark armor, cloth, restrained amber fasteners, top-down three-quarter camera. This is purpose-built low-resolution pixel art: a 64x64 logical canvas with body 55 logical pixels tall, feet at logical (32,60), at least 2 pixels empty gutter. If output is larger, render an exact integer enlargement of that logical pixel grid. Huge simple connected planes: distinct head/hair/skin, shoulder masses, torso armor, forearms/hands, two clearly separated legs/boots. Critical limbs >=3 logical px, negative gaps >=2 logical px. No weapon because the existing base is unarmed and equipment sockets are separate. Human warrior must read immediately at 1x. Use 12-16 colors from ash #161820 #272B36 #414653 #626777, bone/skin #655344 #9B8564 #D0B88A #F1DDB0, cloth #332C40 #54435D #7A607D, amber #B87825 #E9B94A. Three large value planes on armor, NOT hundreds of tiny metallic flecks. No texture/noise/dithering, tiny trim, checkerboard, ground, glow, shadow, labels, borders, smooth gradients or anti-aliasing. Genuine transparent background. Single centered full-body pose. Keep the accepted dark fantasy identity; do not imitate Stardew Valley artwork.
